LuaScript:
function onLoad()
    createSetupButtons()
end

function createSetupButtons()
    FLAGS = {
        ['USE_TO_VARIANT'] = false,
    }

    BUTTON_Y = 0
    BUTTON_SCALE = 1
    
    INT_BOARD = 'f9da22'
    BOARD = '1ce60c'

    local int_board = getObjectFromGUID(INT_BOARD)
    local board = getObjectFromGUID(BOARD)
    local bScale = 1.5 * board.getScale()
    local hScale = 2.5 * board.getScale()


    board.createButton({
        label = "int ->",
        width = 2700,
        height = 699,
        position = { -0.55, 0.05, 0.8 },
        scale = { 1 / hScale.x, 1 / hScale.y, 1 / hScale.z },
        font_size = 549,
        click_function = "rotateIntRight",
        color = {0.31, 0.733, 0.961}, -- Color del botón
        font_color = {1, 1, 1} -- Color del texto (blanco)
    })
    board.createButton({
        label = "int <-",
        width = 2700,
        height = 699,
        position = { -0.55, 0.05, 1 },
        scale = { 1 / hScale.x, 1 / hScale.y, 1 / hScale.z },
        font_size = 549,
        click_function = "rotateIntLeft",
        color = {0.31, 0.733, 0.961}, -- Color del botón
        font_color = {1, 1, 1} -- Color del texto (blanco)
    })
end

function rotateIntRight()
    rotate(36, INT_BOARD)
end

function rotateIntLeft()
    rotate(-36, INT_BOARD)
end

function rotate(rotation, boardRef) 
    local board = getObjectFromGUID(boardRef)
    local currentRotation = board.getRotation()
    local newRotation = { x = currentRotation.x, y = currentRotation.y + rotation, z = currentRotation.z }   
    board.setRotationSmooth(newRotation, false, true)
end
